answer: An auditor observes that unanchored claims are cheap to fake. Under this rule, each answer must embed at least one checkable claim whose source digest is committed on-chain at submission and replayed at settlement; a claim failing replay voids the answer. The claim space is a dune field: verifiers sample random grains, so no farm knows which will be checked. Sources cluster - a nebula of answers citing one fabricated well collapses into a single share. An oasis is scarce: the registry logs digger, depth and date of every well, and violations are recorded as permanent liens.
